description:
`skills/xy-development/workflow.md` names the three completion stages "Layer 1 — Generic DoD", "Layer 2 — Domain DoD" and "Layer 3 — Project-specific criteria" (see "Applying the Definition of Done", ~line 127). xyo-skills numbers its skill stack in layers too (L1 `xy-development` … L9 `xl1-build`), so "Layer 2" read two ways. xyo-skills now calls these **Gate 1 / Gate 2 / Gate 3** (its dApp Definition of Done, xl1-build's PRD template and xl1-scaffold's completion gate) and adds a note mapping them to this skill's "layers".

Proposal: rename the completion stages here to Gate 1/2/3 (keeping the existing headings' anchors stable, or redirecting them), so both packs use one vocabulary and the mapping note can go.
title: xy-development: call the completion stages Gate 1/2/3 instead of Layer 1/2/3
